nodes.description: Public token name string storage variable for the AllfiShare token.
Public token symbol storage variable, set to 'AFS'.
Public uint8 decimals value, set to 18.
Private total token supply storage variable (50000 * 10^18).
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated in transfer, transferFrom and constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; performs unchecked subtraction in Solidity 0.5.
Returns balances[tokenOwner]; read-only ERC20 view.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]; read-only ERC20 view.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-address or return-value check.
Debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd; emits Transfer.
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub, credits balances[to] via safeAdd; does not verify allowance sufficiency beyond safeSub revert.
Library-style addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Library-style subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Library-style multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
Library-style division with require(b > 0) division-by-zero guard.
Caller-controlled address used as minter, approver, transfer sender and spender in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply (arithmetic underflow risk).
Addition a + b inside safeAdd guarded only by require(c >= a).
Subtraction a - b inside safeSub guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
address tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf, used as mapping key into balances.
address tokenOwner parameter of allowance, used as outer mapping key into allowed.
address spender parameter of allowance, used as inner mapping key into allowed.
address spender parameter of approve, stored into allowed[msg.sender].
uint tokens parameter of approve, stored as the approved allowance amount.
address to parameter of transfer, destination credited via safeAdd.
uint tokens parameter of transfer, amount moved from msg.sender to receiver.
address from parameter of transferFrom, source debited via safeSub.
address to parameter of transferFrom, destination credited via safeAdd.
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom, amount moved from 'from' to 'to'.
uint a parameter of safeAdd, left operand of the addition.
uint b parameter of safeAdd, right operand of the addition.
uint c local result of safeAdd, holds a + b.
uint a parameter of safeSub, left operand of the subtraction.
uint b parameter of safeSub, right operand of the subtraction.
uint c local result of safeSub, holds a - b.
uint a parameter of safeMul, left operand of the multiplication.
uint b parameter of safeMul, right operand of the multiplication.
uint c local result of safeMul, holds a * b.
uint a parameter of safeDiv, numerator of the division.
uint b parameter of safeDiv, denominator checked with require(b > 0).
uint c local result of safeDiv, holds a / b.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor as the recipient of the initial supply via balances[msg.sender].
Constructor writes the constant string 'Allfi Share' into the name state variable.
Constructor writes the constant string 'AFS' into the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes 18 into the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply value of 50000e18.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the first operand of its return expression.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] and subtracts it from _totalSupply.
_totalSupply feeds the unchecked subtraction expression evaluated inside totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] feeds the unchecked subtraction, so a burn to address(0) reduces the returned supply without a guard.
The totalSupply function executes the unchecked arithmetic operation when called.
balanceOf uses the tokenOwner parameter as the key to read balances.
balanceOf receives tokenOwner as its input parameter.
balanceOf returns the value read from the balances mapping.
allowance receives tokenOwner as the outer key parameter.
allowance receives spender as the inner key parameter.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve receives the spender address parameter to be authorised.
approve receives the tokens amount parameter to be stored as allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key when writing the allowance mapping.
msg.sender is the outer key of allowed when the caller approves a spender.
The spender parameter becomes the inner key of the allowed mapping entry.
The tokens parameter becomes the allowance value written into the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender] of the caller.
transfer receives the destination address parameter 'to'.
transfer receives the amount parameter 'tokens'.
transfer calls safeSub to compute the sender's new balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to compute the recipient's new balance.
transfer mutates balances for both msg.sender and the recipient.
safeSub executes its subtraction expression a - b.
safeAdd executes its addition expression a + b.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key allowed[from][msg.sender] and as the caller identity.
transferFrom receives the source address parameter 'from'.
transferFrom receives the destination address parameter 'to'.
transferFrom receives the amount parameter 'tokens'.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] but never validates the allowance is sufficient before safeSub.
safeAdd receives operand a as a parameter.
safeAdd receives operand b as a parameter.
Parameter a is the left operand of the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is the right operand of the addition in safeAdd.
The addition result is stored in local variable c in safeAdd.
safeSub receives operand a as a parameter.
safeSub receives operand b as a parameter.
Parameter a is the left operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is the right operand and the require(b <= a) guard of safeSub.
The subtraction result is stored in local variable c in safeSub.
safeMul receives operand a as a parameter.
safeMul receives operand b as a parameter.
Parameter a is the left operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is the right operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored in local variable c in safeMul.
safeDiv receives numerator a as a parameter.
safeDiv receives denominator b as a parameter.
Parameter a is the numerator of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator of the division and is guarded by require(b > 0).
The division result is stored in local variable c in safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter only serves as the lookup key for the balanceOf view function and has no independent behaviour.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used as the outer key of allowed inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only used as the inner key of allowed inside allowance.
The spender parameter is written directly into allowed[msg.sender][spender] by approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approve.
The to parameter is only meaningful as the credited account of the transfer routine.
The tokens parameter is the amount consumed by the transfer routine.
The from parameter is only meaningful as the debited account of transferFrom.
The to parameter is only meaningful as the credited account of transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the addition expression in safeAdd.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the addition expression in safeAdd.
Local c only receives the result of the addition and is then returned.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the subtraction expression in safeSub.
Parameter b is a pure operand and underflow guard of the subtraction in safeSub.
Local c only receives the result of the subtraction and is then returned.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the multiplication expression in safeMul.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the multiplication expression in safeMul.
Local c only receives the result of the multiplication and is then returned.
Parameter a is the numerator of the division expression in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator and division-by-zero guard of safeDiv.
Local c only receives the result of the division and is then returned.
